learningObjectives: Differentiate unit, integration, and end-to-end testing approaches.
Identify suitable tests for frontend and backend components.
Apply testing strategies to validate full stack application behavior.

activities.title: Testing Pyramid
activities.instruction: Explore the layers of the testing pyramid.

content.concept: The testing pyramid organizes tests by scope, with smaller focused tests supporting broader integration and end-to-end tests.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Test Type Match
activities.instruction: Match scenarios with the appropriate test type.

content.concept: Unit tests isolate small pieces of logic, integration tests verify connected components, and end-to-end tests validate complete user flows.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Test Execution Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a test workflow.

content.concept: A testing workflow typically defines test cases, prepares data, executes tests, evaluates results, and reports failures.

activities.title: Test Suite Builder
activities.instruction: Build a test strategy for a full stack feature.

content.concept: A balanced test suite validates frontend behavior, backend logic, API integration, and critical user journeys.
